narration: That is the double hit. One habit, two wounds, pointing in opposite directions.
caption: यही दोहरी चोट है। एक आदत, दो घाव, दोनों उलटी दिशा में।
image_brief: A frayed rope lying on a dusty floor pulled taut between two iron hooks, both ends unravelling, light from a high window.

narration: Take a recurring cost of one thousand a month. Twelve thousand a year.
caption: मान लें हर महीने एक हज़ार का पक्का खर्च। साल में बारह हज़ार।
image_brief: Twelve identical coins laid in a straight line along the edge of a kitchen shelf, evening light coming through the doorway.

narration: Twenty-five times twelve thousand is three lakh. That is the pot it demands.
caption: बारह हज़ार का पच्चीस गुना है तीन लाख। इतना फंड यह खर्च माँगता है।
image_brief: A single thick bundle of banded banknotes standing upright on a bare table beside one loose coin, cool daylight.

narration: So a thousand a month is a three lakh commitment. Permanently.
caption: तो हर महीने का एक हज़ार तीन लाख का वादा है। हमेशा के लिए।
image_brief: A brass padlock clamped through the handle of a heavy wooden chest in a storeroom, thin light from a ventilator above.

narration: Shorten that. Any monthly amount times three hundred gives the pot behind it.
caption: छोटा तरीक़ा: किसी भी मासिक रकम को तीन सौ से गुणा करें।
image_brief: A long paper till roll unspooled across a shop floor, curling at the far end, fluorescent light overhead.

narration: Three hundred, because twenty-five years of twelve months is three hundred months.
caption: तीन सौ, क्योंकि पच्चीस साल के बारह महीने तीन सौ महीने होते हैं।
image_brief: A wall of small square post-office letter boxes filling the frame, rows of identical numbered doors, flat indoor light.

narration: Now the second link. What builds the pot is the gap, not the pay.
caption: अब दूसरी कड़ी। फंड सैलरी से नहीं, कमाई और खर्च के अंतर से बनता है।
image_brief: Two boulders in a shallow stream with water running fast through the narrow gap between them, bright sun overhead.

narration: Income minus spending. That gap is the only money that ever arrives inside.
caption: कमाई घटाओ खर्च। यही अंतर वह पैसा है जो फंड तक पहुँचता है।
image_brief: A tap running into a wide steel basin while an open drain beside it carries most of the water away, cool morning light.

narration: Compounding then works on whatever sits inside. It cannot work on money already spent.
caption: चक्रवृद्धि उसी पर काम करती है जो अंदर है। खर्च हुए पैसे पर नहीं।
image_brief: A ball of dough rolled along a floured kitchen slab, visibly larger at the far end of its path, window light.

narration: Here is why income cancels out. Double the pay and double the spending.
caption: कमाई का असर यहाँ कटता है। सैलरी दोगुनी, खर्च भी दोगुना।
image_brief: Two identical market stalls facing each other across a lane, one piled twice as high with produce, midday sun.

narration: The gap doubles, so deposits double. The target doubles too, at the same moment.
caption: अंतर दोगुना, जमा दोगुनी। लक्ष्य भी उसी समय दोगुना हो जाता है।
image_brief: Two glass jars on a shelf, one twice the height of the other, each filled to exactly the same marked level, soft daylight.

narration: A doubled deposit against a doubled target is the same journey. Ratio unchanged.
caption: दोगुनी जमा और दोगुना लक्ष्य मिलकर वही सफ़र बनाते हैं। अनुपात वही रहा।
image_brief: Two staircases of different widths inside a stairwell, both ending at the same landing door, light from a skylight.

narration: Which leaves the fraction. Savings rate, and nothing about the size of the salary.
caption: बचता है सिर्फ़ अनुपात। बचत दर, और सैलरी के आकार से कोई मतलब नहीं।
image_brief: A single wooden block resting on the upper half of a chalk line drawn across a courtyard floor, long evening shadows.

narration: Two earners far apart, one shared fraction, one finish line. Now the numbers.
caption: कमाई में दूर-दूर दो लोग, एक जैसा अनुपात, एक ही मंज़िल। अब आँकड़े।
image_brief: Two running lanes on a dusty track converging at one taut finish tape, early morning light and long shadows.

narration: Round figures ahead, chosen to be easy. They are illustrative, not a forecast.
caption: आगे के आँकड़े गोल और आसान हैं। ये सिर्फ़ उदाहरण हैं, भविष्यवाणी नहीं।
image_brief: A clean notebook page open on a desk with a sharpened pencil and a steel ruler beside it, bright even daylight.
